S.FORM: batad nu wali (kamu nu Hulam: 遠東 ) u katinengan nu salengacay a tademaw i "tipay" . u batad nu wali hananay ku sawalian nu "nutipan nu Europe" . i tepal ku "untipan nu Europe" , u "tepalay a wali" hananay. izaw ku "nuwalian nu O-Cuo" (East Europe, 東歐), "nuwalitimulan nu Europe" , "nuamisan nu Africa " atu Turkey . u "inutebanan nu walian" hananay izaw ku "nuwalian nu Africa" , Li-Fan-Te (黎凡特, Lavent ), A-La-Po pangkiw a subal atu "inutebanan nu Asia" . "batad nu wali" saan sa, namaka kakitidaan atu kitakit nu European a tademaw , u lala' i batad nu wali mueneng ku takuliyaway a tademaw . sakawalian sabataday a China , Korea North , atu Japan , u "nuwalian nu Asia" hananay. sisa u batad nu wali saan sa. izaw ku henay Siberia , u "nuamisan nu Asia" hananay, atu "walitimulan nu Asia" .
S.PHON: batad nu war~ɾi (kamu nu ħur~ɾam: ** ) u katinəŋan nu sar~ɾəŋaʦaj a tadəmaw i "tipaj" . u batad nu war~ɾi ħananaj ku sawar~ɾian nu "nutipan nu əuropə" . i təpar~ɾ ku "untipan nu əuropə" , u "təpar~ɾaj a war~ɾi" ħananaj. izaw ku "nuwar~ɾian nu o-ʦuo" (əast əuropə, **), "nuwar~ɾitimur~ɾan nu əuropə" , "nuamisan nu afriʦa " atu turkə . u "inutəbanan nu war~ɾian" ħananaj izaw ku "nuwar~ɾian nu afriʦa" , r~ɾi-fan-tə (***, r~ɾa*ənt ), a-r~ɾa-po paŋkiw a subar~ɾ atu "inutəbanan nu asia" . "batad nu war~ɾi" saan sa, namaka kakitidaan atu kitakit nu əuropəan a tadəmaw , u r~ɾar~ɾaʔ~ʡ i batad nu war~ɾi muənəŋ ku takur~ɾijawaj a tadəmaw . sakawar~ɾian sabatadaj a ʦħina , korəa nortħ , atu *apan , u "nuwar~ɾian nu asia" ħananaj. sisa u batad nu war~ɾi saan sa. izaw ku ħənaj sibəria , u "nuamisan nu asia" ħananaj, atu "war~ɾitimur~ɾan nu asia" .
